name: RF01: Thermal Compliance Crisis
description: Global count of shipments where iot_temperature is < 0 or > 15 (11,598 breaches).

name: RF02: Supplier Integrity Audit
description: Identification of carriers with frequent temperature violations above 8.0C.

name: RF03: Status Casting Resolution
description: Logic to handle order_fulfillment_status as VARCHAR to prevent numeric conversion errors.

name: RF04: Thermal Volatility (RTE_01007)
description: Statistical variance audit to find inconsistent cooling on specific routes.

name: RF05: Bimodal Peaks (RTE_00727)
description: Detection of two distinct temperature clusters indicating cooling equipment failure.

name: RF06: Delay Frequency Ceiling
description: Top 10 routes where delivery_time_deviation > 0 occurs in over 96% of cases.
sql: AVG(CASE WHEN delivery_time_deviation > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0.96

name: RF07: Supplier SUP_00726 Failure
description: Documenting specific supplier with a near-total (>99%) delay rate.

name: RF08: Supplier SUP_00548 Failure
description: Documenting secondary supplier with a near-total (>99%) delay rate.

name: RF09: ID Padding Resolution
description: Handling leading zero inconsistencies for supplier IDs (e.g. SUP_00875 vs SUP_875).

name: RF10: 39.25% FTR Ceiling
description: Measuring the cap on 'Perfect Shipments' (On-Time + Thermal Integrity) for SUP_00358.

name: RF11: 47.64% Cost Variance
description: Isolating supplier billing anomalies compared to the global network average.

name: RF12: Statistical Outlier (Z-Score)
description: Isolating extreme tail-risk incidents where temperature Z-Score exceeds 4.5.

name: RF13: $28M Spend Concentration
description: Single-point-of-failure risk based on total financial volume for SUP_00101.

name: RF14: Bottleneck RTE_00052
description: Quantifying total time-loss impact (Volume * Avg Delay) for the most congested route.

name: RF15: Mean Imputation Artifact
description: Detecting data quality flatlining where 18.6C is over-represented in sensor data.

name: RF16: Geospatial Hot-Zones
description: Mapping failure clusters using 11.1km GPS coordinate rounding (1 decimal place).

name: RF17: Cost Volatility Audit
description: Measuring standard deviation in billing to identify anomalous supplier behavior.

name: RF18: Temperature-Linked Delays
description: Correlation check between thermal compliance breaches and delivery time deviation.

name: RF19: 0.1% Catastrophic Deviation
description: Isolating the worst-performing 0.1% of delivery time outliers for risk mitigation.

name: KPI: Total Shipment Volume
description: Measures total network scale and throughput.

name: KPI: Fulfillment Status Distribution
description: Percentage breakdown of Delivered, Delayed, and Pending shipments.

name: KPI: Volume by Shift
description: Identifies peak periods (Morning/Afternoon/Night) for staffing optimization.
sql: CASE WHEN HOUR(timestamp) BETWEEN 6 AND 14 THEN 'Morning'...

name: KPI: Asset Utilization Rate
description: Ratio of unique vehicles used in shipments vs. total fleet size.

name: KPI: Average Delivery Time Deviation
description: Global measure of ETA accuracy (Positive = Late, Negative = Early).

name: KPI: Route Lead-Time Analysis
description: Compares delivery delays across different route risk levels.

name: KPI: Bottleneck Identification
description: Impact Score = Volume * Average Delay for every route.

name: KPI: Route Circuitry
description: Identifies planned vs. actual movement efficiency using GPS variance.

name: KPI: Total Spend by Supplier
description: Total logistics financial throughput per vendor.

name: KPI: Average Shipping Cost per Route
description: Geographical distribution of spend per corridor.

name: KPI: Cost-to-Weight Efficiency
description: Measures transport cost per unit of weight (Inbound/Outbound).

name: KPI: Cost-to-Carrier Variance
description: Identifies carriers charging significantly above network averages.

name: KPI: Rolling Spend Trends
description: 7-day moving average of total logistics costs.
sql: AVG(shipping_costs) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)

name: KPI: Critical Temperature Breach Rate
description: Volume of product safety violations (>15°C).
sql: SUM(CASE WHEN iot_temperature > 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)

name: KPI: Thermal Compliance Rate
description: % of shipments maintaining standard 0-15°C environment.

name: KPI: Average Temperature Stability
description: Consistency of the cold chain using Standard Deviation.

name: KPI: Condition-Based Risk Score
description: Composite score (0-100) based on Thermal, Delay, and Cost risks.

name: KPI: Load Distribution
description: Workload balance across the vendor network to identify over-reliance.

name: KPI: Carrier Delay Frequency
description: % of late deliveries per supplier.

name: KPI: Vendor Thermal Integrity
description: Ranking suppliers by their ability to maintain compliance.

name: KPI: Supplier Reliability Gap
description: Gap between promised reliability score and actual compliance.
